references.observed: Inauguration material identifies the four midlevel outlets, arch shape, thrust block, diversion tunnels and separate power intake.
The upstream photograph shows four raised gate-headwork stacks and orange gantries, the separate cantilevered orange power intake crane and the uninterrupted roadway.
The construction-era photo establishes the vertical arch sweep and narrow gorge. Temporary work platforms and uncontrolled discharge are outside the current model.
The reservoir edge and river meet at the dam. The separate station POI and approach tunnels corroborate the site.
